Iron(VI) oxide and carbon are heated in a furnace to extract iron from the ore. The balanced chemical equation for the reaction is:
$2\text{Fe}_2\text{O}_3(\text{s}) + 3\text{C}(\text{s}) \to 4\text{Fe}(\ell) + 3\text{CO}_2(\text{g})$
question: State TWO advantages of open-cast mining when compared to deep-shaft (underground) mining.
memo:
Any TWO:
- Cheaper/Less expensive.
- Safer / Fewer health hazards.
- Easier to access minerals/ores.
- More efficient extraction / Higher yield of ore recovery.
final_answer: Cheaper, safer, easier access, more efficient extraction.
